_about: Structural flags for the moat caps (spec layer 2), set by hand, reviewed yearly. single_product = one drug/product whose loss would sink the company (not one business line); patent_cliff = key patent expires within 5 years with no replacement over 20% of revenue; mlm; fashion; market_making; fragmented = fragmented market and no switching costs; big_customer = largest customer over 20% of revenue (disclosed only; governments not counted). Loaded with scripts/load-moat-flags.mjs.

IRWD.note: LINZESS is about 95% of revenue; licensed generics of the main doses from March 2029.

MRNA.note: COVID vaccine (Spikevax) is most of revenue.

MRK.note: Keytruda (about 45% of revenue) loses US patent protection around 2028.

BMY.note: Eliquis and Opdivo lose patent protection around 2028.

PFE.note: Several large drugs lose patent protection by 2028.

NKE.note: Sneaker and sportswear demand follows trends.

SBC.note: Fragmented aesthetic-clinic market, patients can switch easily.

CVNA.note: Fragmented used-car market, buyers shop on price.

COR.note: Walgreens and Boots were about 25% of fiscal 2025 revenue.
